select 
                                      object_id,
                                      b_info_windcode,
                                      b_mkt,
                                      b_con_windcode,
                                      b_name,
                                      b_info_type,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      b_info_listingmarketnumbers,
                                      b_code_ib,
                                      b_code_sh,
                                      b_code_sz,
                                      b_anal_yield_csi,
                                      b_anal_modidura_csi_m,
                                      b_anal_modidura_csi,
                                      b_anal_convexity,
                                      b_dq_volume,
                                      b_dq_amount,
                                      b_anal_accruedinterest,
                                      b_analysis_class,
                                      b_name_ib,
                                      b_info_listdate_ib,
                                      b_name_sh,
                                      b_info_listdate_sh,
                                      b_name_sz,
                                      b_info_listdate_sz,
                                      b_weight,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_csitotalbondindemembers.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.csitotalbondindemembers WHERE trade_dt = '${p_dt}'
